description: The bar chart illustrates model performance by reporting two accuracy metrics, MMAU and MMAR, for three audio-capable models. The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled (left to right) “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70 with regularly spaced tick marks every 10 percentage points. For each model, there are two adjacent bars: an MMAU bar shown in a darker blue and an MMAR bar shown in a purple tone, as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. For “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” the MMAU bar is just under 50% (approximately 49%) and the MMAR bar is about 30%; for “Audio-Reasoner,” the MMAU bar is a little above 60% (approximately 61%) and the MMAR bar is in the mid-30s (approximately 36%); for “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” the MMAU bar is in the mid-60s (approximately 65%) and the MMAR bar is in the mid-to-high 50s (approximately 56%). The bars are grouped by model with consistent color coding for the two metrics, there is no stacking, and there are no visible annotations or special visual emphasis beyond the legend and standard bar coloring; the category order appears to follow the listed model names rather than an explicitly indicated sorting rule.
